system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform action: Fetches current commodity prices for a specific mandi. Here are my details: my commodity is dummy_commodity_4149, my location is dummy_location_5497.

function.name: enam_get_arrival_data
function.description: Retrieves arrival quantities and demand trends for a commodity at a mandi. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT show prices — use enam_get_mandi_prices. Fails if mandi or commodity is unsupported.

function.name: enam_get_mandi_prices
function.description: Fetches current commodity prices for a specific mandi. Returns modal, minimum, and maximum prices with quality grades. PUBLIC tool — no auth required. Does NOT execute buy/sell transactions. Fails if commodity or mandi is unsupported, or no price data is available. Prices may be delayed.

commodity.description: Standardized commodity name (e.g., paddy, wheat, cotton).
